messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Extended-release capsules and tablets
Tramadol ER 100 mg once a day (one 100 mg tablet or capsule) at approximately the same time each day.
Can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed, to a maximum of 300 mg a day, taken as one dose once a day.
Extended-release tramadol is not intended for as-needed pain relief.
It should not be taken with any other tramadol product.
Dosage in kidney or liver impairment
Severe kidney impairment requires specific dosing adjustments for immediate-release tramadol.
For this condition, doses are spaced 12 hours apart.
The maximum daily dose is 200 mg.
This maximum consists of four 50 mg tablets.
These tablets are given as two 100 mg doses.
The doses are administered 12 hours apart.
Severe liver impairment is a condition.
For immediate-release tramadol, the recommended dose is 50 mg (one 50 mg tablet) every 12 hours.
This is 100 mg a day.
Extended-release tramadol is not recommended for people with severe kidney or severe liver impairment.
Dosage in older adults
No separate maximum dose applies on the basis of age.
Triples: [["Tramadol", "has dosage form", "extended-release capsules"], ["Tramadol", "has dosage form", "extended-release tablets"], ["Tramadol ER", "has recommended dose", "100 mg once a day"], ["Tramadol ER", "has administration instruction", "taken at approximately the same time each day"], ["Tramadol ER", "has dose adjustment instruction", "can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed"], ["Tramadol ER", "has maximum daily dose", "300 mg a day"], ["Tramadol ER", "has administration instruction", "taken as one dose once a day"], ["Tramadol ER", "has warning", "not intended for as-needed pain relief"], ["Tramadol ER", "should be avoided with", "other tramadol product"], ["Tramadol", "has dosage adjustment in", "severe kidney impairment"], ["Tramadol", "has dosage adjustment in", "severe liver impairment"], ["Tramadol", "has dosage adjustment instruction", "doses spaced 12 hours apart"], ["Tramadol", "has maximum daily dose", "200 mg"], ["Tramadol", "has maximum daily dose composition", "four 50 mg tablets"], ["Tramadol", "has administration instruction", "given as two 100 mg doses"], ["Tramadol", "has administration instruction", "doses administered 12 hours apart"], ["Tramadol", "has recommended dose", "50 mg (one 50 mg tablet) every 12 hours"], ["Tramadol", "has daily dose", "100 mg a day"], ["Tramadol ER", "contraindicated in", "people with severe kidney impairment"], ["Tramadol ER", "contraindicated in", "people with severe liver impairment"], ["Tramadol", "has dosage adjustment instruction", "no separate maximum dose applies on the basis of age"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has administration instruction", "has daily dose", "has dosage adjustment in", "has dosage adjustment instruction", "has dosage form", "has dose adjustment instruction", "has maximum daily dose", "has maximum daily dose composition", "has recommended dose", "has warning", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has administration instruction: The subject drug should be administered according to the specific instructions provided by the object entity.
has daily dose: The subject drug is taken in the daily dose amount specified by the object entity.
has dosage adjustment in: The subject drug requires specific dosage adjustments for patients with the condition specified by the object entity.
has dosage adjustment instruction: The subject drug requires specific dosage adjustments according to the instructions provided by the object entity.
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has dose adjustment instruction: The subject drug's dose can be adjusted according to the instructions provided by the object entity.
has maximum daily dose: The subject drug should not exceed the maximum daily dose specified by the object entity.
has maximum daily dose composition: The subject drug's maximum daily dose is composed of the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
has recommended dose: The subject drug is recommended to be taken in the dose specified by the object entity.
has warning: The subject drug has a specific warning or caution associated with it, as described by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
